about: Perks track PK-2: the Perks' pictures as flat 34x34 fronts in the UI icon builder's letters (ICON_PALETTE in game/js/logic/icon-block.js; '.' is empty; digits 1-4 are the light, mid, dark and ink of the one ICON_RAMPS hue `mono` names, letters then accents). tools/build-icons.mjs shades each with iconBlockKeyed and writes game/art/perks/<id>.svg once perks.json names it (img); after that the SVG is the source (the Studio's icon editor), and the grid is kept as the first drawing. The 8 PK-0 samples (docs/samples/perk-icon-samples.json, deleted 2026-10-28, in git history) plus the 12 other existing Perks drawn in PK-2. PK-3 drew the 11 other Wave A pictures (perks-track.md 5.2). PK-4 drew the 13 other Wave B pictures (perks-track.md 5.3; Bellows and Umbrella are PK-0 samples). PK-5 drew the 12 Wave C pictures (catching, cash and maps). PK-6 drew the 11 Wave D pictures (rules, growth and adventure; Correction Fluid waits for PK-9). PK-7 drew the 11 other Fine Print pictures (perks-track.md 5.6; Glass Trophy is a PK-0 sample). PK-9 drew Correction Fluid.
